detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Status of Autonomous Inquiry Project
detail.summary: Current research into 'Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation' (proj-autonomous-inquiry-001) is active but constrained by the exhaustion of available search slots. The existing notebook (nb-autonomous-inquiry-001) synthesizes historical curiosity and observation, but requires further technical evidence regarding algorithmic implementation for artificial agents to progress. Research activities for this project are paused until search capacity is replenished.
